title: Retire four unused internal shell wrappers after verifying active replacements

source.ref: Exact d2ccb8ffc graph and actual retained Frequency footer, personal rail, dispatch board and dock paths

detail: Removed exactly four modules with no runtime/type/CLI/test/probe source consumers: dispatch-ticker-slot, dock-segment, member-footer and my-frequency-menu. The actual Frequency member shell mounts FqMegaFooter with the same role-filtered visibleFooterColumns and renders live personal circles/operator work groups. Actual /nearby mounts its audience-filtered dispatch board marquee; the live rail registry retains DispatchesPanel. GameStatsDock intentionally retains its own dismissal/channel implementation and live DockBar helpers; no dock behavior or shared helper is removed. Historical old global ticker motion fixes remain historical, not a requirement to resurrect DAWN chrome. Retained DispatchTicker/chrome-reserves tests and all shared APIs. Updated the mobile-nav historical source pointer. All-tree AST edge census and planted actual-entry import/re-export/dynamic-import controls protect against dangling imports; mounted replacement and actual-source mutation controls protect the retained feature paths. No claim that test-only/CLI/type roots are dead or that the whole application has zero orphans.
